import numpy as np
base=[np.ones_like(x),x,x**2,x**3,1/x,x/v,v]
bn=['1','x','x2','x3','1/x','x/v','v']
cands={'exp(-x)':np.exp(-x),'x*exp(-x)':x*np.exp(-x),'exp(-x^2)':np.exp(-x**2),'x^2exp(-x)':x**2*np.exp(-x),'exp(-2x)':np.exp(-2*x),'exp(-v)':np.exp(-v),'exp(-x/v)':np.exp(-x/v),'1/x^2':1/x**2,'x/v^2':x/v**2,'exp(x)':np.exp(x)}
for k,f in cands.items():
    B=np.column_stack(base+[f]); cc=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print(k, np.mean((dv_dt-B@cc)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
# also drop base terms and try pure exp models
for drop in ['1/x','x/v','x3','x2']:
    keep=[(b,n) for b,n in zip(base,bn) if n!=drop]
    B=np.column_stack([b for b,n in keep]+[np.exp(-x)]); cc=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print('drop',drop, np.mean((dv_dt-B@cc)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
